articles.title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification
articles.selectionReason: Open full-text paper; topic brain_computer_interface; quality signal passed; application scenario is clear.

paperCard.problem: 运动想象脑电信号在不同时间记录的session之间信号分布会变化，导致同一个模型在今天的分类准确率到了明天就下降很多。现有模型难以应对这种跨session的不稳定性。
paperCard.method: 提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，它在原有的ATCNet基础上新增了一个轻量级的通道集成注意力模块，能够自动学会哪些脑电通道和频带对分类更重要，并让模型在时间维度上更稳定。
paperCard.difference: 之前的ATCNet主要关注时间窗口上的注意力，但忽略了不同脑电通道之间的重要性差异；新方法通过频带注意力显式区分不同频率成分的贡献，并用一个交叉门控机制把通道信息和时间信息融合起来。
paperCard.innovation: 创新点有两个：一是频带注意力，它把特征通道分成若干组，相当于模拟了不同脑电节律，然后给每个组自适应打分；二是交叉门控，它让时间注意力的输出受到当前通道信息的调节，实现了通道与时间的双向交互。
paperCard.implementation: 首先用三个不同尺寸的卷积核并行提取多尺度时间特征；然后经过频带注意力+交叉门控模块（FBA-CIAM）进行时空精炼；接着用带ECA注意力的膨胀卷积模块提取长期依赖；最后用注意力机制池化多个滑动窗口的特征，分类输出。
paperCard.applications: 适用于任何需要识别想象动作的脑机接口系统，比如智能假肢控制、神经康复训练、游戏娱乐等，尤其适合需要多次使用（跨场景）的长期应用。
technicalTerms: 运动想象（Motor Imagery）：人想象自己动手或动脚，但实际不做动作，大脑会产生跟真实运动相似的电信号
EEG：脑电图，从头皮记录大脑电活动
跨session：不同时间记录的实验轮次，比如上周和本周的数据
注意力机制：让模型自动聚焦重要信息，忽略无关信息
卷积神经网络：一种能提取局部特征的深度学习模型

articles.highlight: 在BCI竞赛IV-2a上达到86.32%准确率，在跨session场景下显著提升分类稳定性与鲁棒性。
articles.summary: 该论文提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，通过集成轻量级通道集成注意力模块和频带注意力机制，解决了运动想象脑电信号在跨session条件下的非平稳性难题。在多个公开数据集上取得了优于现有方法的分类性能。
articles.failureAnalysis: 论文只做了跨session（同人不同天）的实验，没有做跨subject的泛化测试，这是未来需要攻克的难点。
articles.sourceExcerpt: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classiﬁcation Le Huu Son Hai , Nguyen Chi Hai , Truong Viet Vu , Nguyen Phuc Nguyen , Nguyen Thai Anh , and Ngo Hoang Tu ⋆ Faculty of Information Technology, Van Lang School of Technology, Van Lang University, Ho Chi Minh City 70000, Vietnam hai.2274802010212@vanlanguni.vn, hai.2274802010214@vanlanguni.vn, vu.2274802011045@vanlanguni.vn, nguyen.2274802010586@vanlanguni.vn, anh.nt@vlu.edu.vn, tu.nh@vlu.edu.vn Abstract. Motor imagery (MI)-based electroencephalography is widely used in non-invasive brain–computer interfaces (BCIs), but robust decod- ing remains challenging due to inter-subject variability and cross-session non-stationarity. This work proposes ATCNet-CIAM, an enhanced at- tention temporal convolutional network that integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module (CIAM) into the ATCNet frame- work to improve channel-spatial feature representation for MI decoding.

paperCard.problem: 运动想象脑电信号在不同时间记录的session之间信号分布会变化，导致同一个模型在今天的分类准确率到了明天就下降很多。现有模型难以应对这种跨session的不稳定性。
paperCard.method: 提出ATCNet-CIAM模型，它在原有的ATCNet基础上新增了一个轻量级的通道集成注意力模块，能够自动学会哪些脑电通道和频带对分类更重要，并让模型在时间维度上更稳定。
paperCard.difference: 之前的ATCNet主要关注时间窗口上的注意力，但忽略了不同脑电通道之间的重要性差异；新方法通过频带注意力显式区分不同频率成分的贡献，并用一个交叉门控机制把通道信息和时间信息融合起来。
paperCard.innovation: 创新点有两个：一是频带注意力，它把特征通道分成若干组，相当于模拟了不同脑电节律，然后给每个组自适应打分；二是交叉门控，它让时间注意力的输出受到当前通道信息的调节，实现了通道与时间的双向交互。
paperCard.implementation: 首先用三个不同尺寸的卷积核并行提取多尺度时间特征；然后经过频带注意力+交叉门控模块（FBA-CIAM）进行时空精炼；接着用带ECA注意力的膨胀卷积模块提取长期依赖；最后用注意力机制池化多个滑动窗口的特征，分类输出。
paperCard.applications: 适用于任何需要识别想象动作的脑机接口系统，比如智能假肢控制、神经康复训练、游戏娱乐等，尤其适合需要多次使用（跨场景）的长期应用。
technicalTerms: 运动想象（Motor Imagery）：人想象自己动手或动脚，但实际不做动作，大脑会产生跟真实运动相似的电信号
EEG：脑电图，从头皮记录大脑电活动
跨session：不同时间记录的实验轮次，比如上周和本周的数据
注意力机制：让模型自动聚焦重要信息，忽略无关信息
卷积神经网络：一种能提取局部特征的深度学习模型

en.highlight: Achieves 86.32% accuracy on BCI Competition IV-2a and significantly improves classification stability and robustness under cross-session conditions.
en.summary: This paper proposes ATCNet-CIAM, which integrates a lightweight channel-integrated attention module and frequency-band attention to address cross-session non-stationarity in motor imagery EEG. It outperforms existing methods on multiple public datasets.
en.failureAnalysis: The paper only evaluates cross-session (same subject, different day) performance; cross-subject generalization is not addressed and remains future work.
en.title: ATCNet-CIAM for Multi-Session Motor Imagery EEG Signal Classification

paperCard.problem: The distribution of motor imagery EEG signals changes across recording sessions, causing model accuracy to drop over time. Existing models struggle with this cross-session instability.
paperCard.method: Proposes ATCNet-CIAM, which adds a lightweight channel-integrated attention module to ATCNet. It learns which channels and frequency bands are important, making the model more stable across sessions.
paperCard.difference: Previous ATCNet focused only on temporal window attention, ignoring channel importance; the new method uses frequency-band attention to distinguish frequency contributions and a cross-gate mechanism to fuse channel and temporal information.
paperCard.innovation: Two innovations: (1) frequency-band attention that groups channels to simulate EEG rhythms and scores each group adaptively; (2) cross-gating that modulates temporal attention output with channel context, enabling bidirectional channel-temporal interaction.
paperCard.implementation: First, three parallel conv kernels extract multi-scale temporal features. Then FBA-CIAM applies frequency-band attention and cross-gating. Next, dilated TCN blocks with ECA attention capture long-term dependencies. Finally, attention pooling aggregates multiple sliding windows for classification.
paperCard.applications: Any motor-imagery-based BCI system, such as prosthetic control, neurorehabilitation, and gaming, especially for long-term use across multiple sessions.
technicalTerms: Motor Imagery: imagining moving a body part without actual movement, producing brain signals similar to real movement
EEG: electroencephalography, recording electrical brain activity from the scalp
Cross-session: different recording sessions at different times, e.g., last week vs. this week
Attention mechanism: allows the model to focus on important features and ignore irrelevant ones
Convolutional neural network: a deep learning model that extracts local patterns
